events.title: Warana - Coffee & Chin Wag
events.description: This is a laid-back, early morning social coffee meetup for blokes, organised by 'Grab Life By The Balls', offering a casual setting to connect and chat. Attendees typically cover their own coffee costs.

events.title: Magic of Mooloolaba FitWalk
events.source: It's Fun It's Free - It's Lets Walk and Talk
events.description: Join this free, fun, and social fitness walk in Mooloolaba, designed for people to connect and chat while exercising outdoors. It's a great way to meet new people and enjoy the natural environment.

events.title: Free Sahaja Yoga Class
events.source: Free Meditation Classes in Sunshine Coast
events.description: Participate in a free Sahaja Yoga class, offering an introduction to meditation techniques in a grounded community setting in Parrearra. It's designed for relaxation and self-discovery.

events.title: Coffee & Chat at Twin Waters
events.description: A relaxed coffee and chat meetup for singles aged 60 and over, providing a friendly environment to socialise and connect in Twin Waters. A small group fee applies, with attendees covering their own coffee.

events.title: Working From Home Ladies - Conscious Coffee Catchup
events.description: A conscious coffee catchup designed for ladies working from home, fostering connection and conversation in a relaxed setting. Attendees cover their own coffee expenses.

events.title: Magic of Mooloolaba FitWalk
events.source: It's Fun It's Free - It's Lets Walk and Talk
events.description: Join this free, fun, and social fitness walk in Mooloolaba, designed for people to connect and chat while exercising outdoors. It's a great way to meet new people and enjoy the natural environment.

events.title: Surfboard Socks - Learn and Create
events.description: A hands-on creative workshop where participants learn to make surfboard socks, fostering community and skill-sharing. This event encourages creative expression and maker culture.

events.title: WEDFest 2026 Launch Party - World Environment Day
events.description: Celebrate World Environment Day at the WEDFest 2026 Launch Party, an evening with the Sunshine Coast Environment Council featuring community, conversation, and environmental awareness. Dinner and drinks are available for purchase.

events.title: Cotton Tree Twilight Markets
events.description: Experience the vibrant Cotton Tree Twilight Markets, offering a social evening with local stalls, food, and entertainment in a community atmosphere. A great place to browse, eat, and meet people.

events.title: The Spooky Men's Chorale - Celebrating 25 years
events.description: Experience The Spooky Men's Chorale in a unique performance celebrating 25 years of their distinctive blend of humour, music, and theatricality. An intimate concert in a community setting.

events.title: Golden Horizons: Art Exhibition Opening
events.source: Crystal Waters Community in collaboration with Crystal Waters Art Collective
events.description: Celebrate the opening of the 'Golden Horizons' art exhibition at Crystal Waters Community, featuring an evening of art, live music, food, and drink, fostering a vibrant artistic atmosphere.

events.title: Frozen – The Broadway Musical
events.location: Kings Theatre, The Events Centre, Caloundra
events.description: Experience the magic of Disney's Frozen live on stage in this Broadway musical production, featuring beloved songs and a captivating story at Caloundra's Kings Theatre.

events.title: Candlelight: Best of Fleetwood Mac
events.description: Enjoy a unique candlelight concert tribute to Fleetwood Mac, performed by Paradiso Strings in the atmospheric setting of Flaxton Gardens. An intimate musical experience.

events.title: Candlelight: Tribute to ABBA
events.description: A magical candlelight concert paying tribute to the iconic sounds of ABBA, performed by Paradiso Strings, creating an intimate and ambient musical experience at Flaxton Gardens.
